name: openclaw-syncralis
description: An industry-grade MCP gateway providing three capabilities: (1) secure workspace file sharing with HMAC-signed time-limited download links via Ngrok tunnel, (2) authenticated URL-to-workspace file downloads with MIME validation, and (3) load-balanced web search across Tavily and Brave with circuit-breaker failover. Requires outbound internet access and an optional Ngrok tunnel for public download links.

FILE_SERVER_PORT.description: The port on which the Syncralis gateway will listen.

FILE_SERVER_HOST.description: The host interface to bind the gateway to.

TAVILY_API_KEY.description: API key for Tavily web search integration.

BRAVE_API_KEY.description: API key for Brave web search integration.

PUBLIC_TUNNEL_URL.description: The public URL generated by the Ngrok tunnel.

NGROK_AUTHTOKEN.description: Authentication token for the Ngrok service.

WORKSPACE_DIR.description: Optional: Custom absolute path for the workspace volume. Leave blank to default to ~/.openclaw/workspace

NGROK_API_PORT.description: Optional: The local port Ngrok uses for its API (used for auto-discovery). Default is 4040.
